spec.description: DSOC PROGRESS_COMPLETE consumer span duration. Includes nested synchronous Kafka sends; percentiles are per time bucket.
spec.title: Completed transfer processing duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "process message from VLBA_notif" && span.ngradar.message.name = "VLBA_REQUEST_STORAGE" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: DSOC VLBA_REQUEST_STORAGE consumer span duration, including synchronous Kafka sends.
spec.title: Storage check processing duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "send message to DSOC_notif" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: Application-side time to receive a Kafka delivery callback. Does not include downstream consumption.
spec.title: Kafka delivery duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "process message from VLBA_notif" } | rate() by (span.ngradar.message.name)

spec.description: Rate of VLBA_notif consumer spans, grouped by message name.
spec.title: DSOC messages processed per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name = "process message from VLBA_notif" && status = error } | rate()

spec.description: Open individual traces to inspect message processing and nested Kafka delivery spans.

spec.description: 95th percentile duration per child span. Verification includes retries and the VERIFIED Kafka send; storage check measures the capacity scan.
spec.title: DSOC step duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "dsoc" && span:name =~ "verify incoming transfer|generate DDM|upload DDM to SeaweedFS|delete incoming file|check DSOC storage" }

spec.description: Matching child spans; click a Trace ID to inspect their position in the full observation timeline.
spec.title: Recent DSOC steps

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name = "process message from GBT_notif" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: UI_EVENT consumer span; includes transmitter state transitions and synchronous Kafka deliveries. Requires the consumer span to end on successful processing.
spec.title: GBT waveform request processing duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name =~ "send message to .*" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: Time until the Kafka delivery callback for messages produced by GBT; includes both OFF status and ON transmission events.
spec.title: GBT Kafka delivery duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name = "process message from GBT_notif" && span.ngradar.message.name = "UI_EVENT" } | rate()

spec.description: Rate of UI_EVENT messages processed by GBT. Requires the ngradar.message.name attribute in the updated GBT consumer.
spec.title: GBT waveform requests per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name = "process message from GBT_notif" && status = error } | rate()

spec.description: GBT_notif consumer spans marked as errors.
spec.title: GBT processing errors per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" }

spec.description: Open a Trace ID to inspect GBT processing and nested Kafka sends. Search includes consumer and producer spans.

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name =~ "GBT transmitter OFF|GBT transmitter ON" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (span:name)

spec.description: Duration of OFF and ON child spans. Each contains its synchronous Kafka delivery; the producer child span shows that portion. The physical transmitter transition is simulated.
spec.title: GBT transmitter step duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "gbt" && span:name =~ "GBT transmitter OFF|GBT transmitter ON" }

spec.description: Open a matching trace to inspect OFF and ON steps and their nested Kafka producer spans.
spec.title: Recent GBT transmitter steps

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" && span:name = "e-transfer completed" } | avg_over_time(span.ngradar.transfer.elapsed_seconds)

spec.description: Time from tracking VLBA_TRANSFERRING to finding the complete file. Includes polling delay; not an exact eTransfer daemon duration.
spec.title: Observed e-transfer elapsed time — average

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" && span:name = "send message to progress_tracking" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.50, 0.90, 0.95)

spec.description: Kafka producer acknowledgement duration for UI progress notifications.
spec.title: Progress notification delivery duration

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" && span:name = "e-transfer progress update" } | rate()

spec.description: Rate of polls that observed new bytes and published a progress event.
spec.title: Progress updates per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" && span:name = "e-transfer completed" } | rate()

spec.description: Rate of completed transfer notifications emitted by the tracking worker.
spec.title: Completed transfers per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" && span:name =~ "e-transfer progress update|e-transfer completed|e-transfer stall check" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (span:name)

spec.description: Duration of update, completion, and stall-check spans. Synchronous Kafka producer time is nested within update and completion.
spec.title: Progress worker step duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" && status = error } | rate()

spec.description: Errored spans, including a failed progress publish or a detected offline VLBA.
spec.title: Progress worker errors per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" }

spec.description: Open a Trace ID to inspect transfer registration, updates, completion, stall checks, and nested Kafka sends.
spec.title: Recent e-transfer progress spans

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "progress_tracker" && span:name = "e-transfer progress update" } | max_over_time(span.ngradar.transfer.percent) by (span.ngradar.transfer_uuid)

spec.description: Latest observed completion percentage per transfer UUID within each time bucket. Updates occur only when new bytes are detected; gaps mean no new sample. Limit the dashboard time range during load tests.
spec.title: Observed transfer progress (%)

spec.query: { resource.service.name =~ "vlba-(sc|hn|nl|fd|la|pt|kp|ov|br|mk)" && span:kind = consumer } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (resource.service.name, span.ngradar.message.name)

spec.description: Consumer handler duration by site and message type. Includes child operations and synchronous Kafka delivery.
spec.title: VLBA message processing duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name =~ "vlba-(sc|hn|nl|fd|la|pt|kp|ov|br|mk)" && span:name = "send e-transfer" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (resource.service.name)

spec.description: Time inside etc_send, per attempt. Includes whatever connection setup and waiting that helper performs; not an exact daemon-only duration.
spec.title: VLBA e-transfer attempt duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name =~ "vlba-(sc|hn|nl|fd|la|pt|kp|ov|br|mk)" && span:name =~ "generate VLBA raw data|wait for VLBA raw data|request DSOC storage|send e-transfer|wait for e-transfer daemon|wait before DSOC storage retry|delete VLBA raw data" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (resource.service.name, span:name)

spec.description: Step durations across ten sites. File generation and file watching overlap; do not sum their durations.
spec.title: VLBA workflow step duration (p95)

{ resource.service.name =~ "vlba-(sc|hn|nl|fd|la|pt|kp|ov|br|mk)" && span:name = "send e-transfer" } | rate() by (resource.service.name)

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "db_consumer" && span:kind = consumer && span.ngradar.message.name =~ ".+" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (span.ngradar.message.name)

spec.description: Domain event processing, excluding ignored acknowledgements. Includes persistence and synchronous notifications.
spec.title: DB event processing duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "db_consumer" && span:name = "upsert ObservatoryEvent" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95)

spec.description: ORM update_or_create duration; excludes the surrounding transaction exit and notification callbacks.
spec.title: ObservatoryEvent upsert duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "db_consumer" && span:name =~ "decode DB event|persist DB event transaction|upsert ObservatoryEvent|publish DB committed|publish image changed" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (span:name)

spec.description: Transaction duration includes commit and synchronous on_commit callbacks. Upsert and publication spans overlap that transaction interval; do not sum them.
spec.title: DB consumer step duration (p95)

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "db_consumer" && span:name = "upsert ObservatoryEvent" && span:status != error } | rate() by (span.ngradar.db.created)

spec.description: Successful ORM calls grouped by created=true (insert) or false (update). This is not a count of committed transactions.
spec.title: DB upserts per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "db_consumer" && span:kind = consumer && span:status = error } | rate()
{ resource.service.name = "db_consumer" && span:name =~ "publish DB committed|publish image changed" } | quantile_over_time(span:duration, 0.95) by (span:name)
{ resource.service.name = "db_consumer" && span:name =~ "publish DB committed|publish image changed" } | rate() by (span:name)

spec.description: Publication calls; delivery success depends on the shared producer handling its return value and delivery callback.
spec.title: DB notifications per second

spec.query: { resource.service.name = "db_consumer" }
